These products are often offered to employer groups as "bundles ", where the subscribers are offered various hmo and ppo options, with various employer contribution strategies as determined by the employer. We believe this new generation of products provides more (1) choices for the individual consumer, (2) transparency of provider costs, and (3) benefit designs that engage consumers in the costs and effectiveness of health care choices.
